# LatticeDB

> A single-file embedded property-graph database with native vector search, BM25 full-text
> search, durable streams, and graph changefeeds. Relationship traversal, vector similarity,
> text search, and ACID transactions live in one local engine behind one Cypher query layer —
> think SQLite, but for connected data you want to query by relationship, semantics, and text.

LatticeDB is written in Zig, has no runtime dependencies, and embeds in-process with C, Python,
and TypeScript/Node.js bindings. It is MIT licensed and developed at
https://github.com/jeffhajewski/latticedb.

It is not a server. There is no daemon, no network hop, and no separate vector store to keep in
sync — a database is one file on disk.

## Getting started

- [Installation](https://docs.latticedb.org/getting-started/installation): install via curl, pip, or npm
- [Quick Start](https://docs.latticedb.org/getting-started/quickstart): create nodes, edges, and vectors, then query them
- [Core Concepts](https://docs.latticedb.org/getting-started/concepts): nodes, edges, properties, labels, and indexes
- [When to Use LatticeDB](https://docs.latticedb.org/getting-started/when-to-use): where it fits and where it does not

## Guides

- [Building a RAG System](https://docs.latticedb.org/guides/rag-system): chunk, embed, and retrieve with graph context
- [Knowledge Graph Modeling](https://docs.latticedb.org/guides/knowledge-graph): schema design for connected data
- [Working with Embeddings](https://docs.latticedb.org/guides/embeddings): storing and indexing vectors
- [Full-Text Search](https://docs.latticedb.org/guides/full-text-search): BM25 ranking over node properties
- [Durable Streams](https://docs.latticedb.org/guides/durable-streams): append-only streams and changefeeds
- [Transactions and Durability](https://docs.latticedb.org/guides/transactions): ACID semantics and crash safety
- [Performance Tuning](https://docs.latticedb.org/guides/performance-tuning): index and buffer-pool configuration

## Query language

- [Cypher Overview](https://docs.latticedb.org/cypher/overview): the supported dialect
- [MATCH and Patterns](https://docs.latticedb.org/cypher/match): pattern matching over the graph
- [Vector Search](https://docs.latticedb.org/cypher/vector-search): the `<=>` similarity operator
- [Full-Text Search](https://docs.latticedb.org/cypher/full-text-search): the `@@` match operator
- [Variable-Length Paths](https://docs.latticedb.org/cypher/variable-length-paths): multi-hop traversal
- [Functions](https://docs.latticedb.org/cypher/functions): built-in function reference

## API reference

- [C API](https://docs.latticedb.org/api/c): the core embedding interface
- [Python](https://docs.latticedb.org/api/python): the `latticedb` package on PyPI
- [TypeScript / Node.js](https://docs.latticedb.org/api/typescript): the `@hajewski/latticedb` package on npm

## Architecture

- [Overview](https://docs.latticedb.org/architecture/overview): how the engine fits together
- [Graph Storage](https://docs.latticedb.org/architecture/graph-storage): adjacency and property layout
- [Vector Search (HNSW)](https://docs.latticedb.org/architecture/vector-search): the vector index
- [B+Tree](https://docs.latticedb.org/architecture/btree): the primary index structure
- [Write-Ahead Log](https://docs.latticedb.org/architecture/wal): durability and recovery
- [Query Execution](https://docs.latticedb.org/architecture/query-execution): planning and operators

## Optional

- [Benchmarks](https://docs.latticedb.org/performance/benchmarks): measured throughput and latency
- [Competitive Analysis](https://docs.latticedb.org/performance/competitive-analysis): how it compares to other engines
